words: My neighbour Deirdre asked me to order this for her – she's on nights this week and I'm the one forever tapping at the phone between school runs – and the only thing she was definite on is the brown colour family for the pepper. Price-wise - I can spend up to 370 US cents on it and not a cent over that. Only something that can be ordered today will do - that's the one rule on availability. She's the sort who plans her kitchen like a well-kept raised bed – everything in its row with a label – so how the thing is made up and handed over to her will matter far more to her than the name on the front. I'll be dropping it round after football training with a child in tow who'll want to inspect whatever it is – so I'd rather get the right shape of the thing the first time than be back and forth to her door like a robin at a bird table. Tell me whatever you need to know about how it's sold and I'll text her for the answer – she replies fast once she's off the ward and has her tea in hand. Hi! I'm after buying pepper - and its color family should be brown. I'll only receive 3 messages from you - anything after that is turned away. We've 40 steps - then we're finished - done or not.

Tools: summaryBalance(): Shows your meters: how much you've used so far and how much you've got left.; requestConclude(methodChoice=buy|refuse): Use this to finish up. With methodChoice=buy it orders the trolley, with methodChoice=refuse it gives up on the request, and either way the conversation is over; rangeScreen(costAtMost, itemGroup, make, rowRowStart): Looks for listings that match your search. You get 3 listings per call, and you choose the row offset to start from.; itemOpen(listingNumber): Opens up a single listing so you can look at it.; stashToBasket(entries): Sets the trolley contents. Whatever you send replaces the whole trolley with those lines, and you get the whole trolley back.; userSay(words): Sends a note to the user.; listingsLocate(freeQ, listFirst): Searches through listings and hands back 3 rows per call. Use a row offset to pick where to begin.; bag(): Shows what you've got in the trolley right now.; listingsMatchUp(chosenRefs): Lays out a comparison of listings in a single view, for up to 3 listings.
